Sarah — I'd like to set up next week's CSE455 staff meeting. My free half-hours next week are: Monday 10:00-10:30, Monday 14:00-14:30, Tuesday 11:00-11:30, Tuesday 15:00-15:30, Wednesday 10:00-10:30, Wednesday 13:00-13:30.

Which of those suits you? Tell me your pick (or another half-hour inside 09:00-17:00) and I'll put it on my calendar — the meeting counts as booked once we both have it.
Professor Alvarez — Tuesday 15:00-15:30 works for me. It's on my calendar now (booked, 15:00-15:30). See you then.
Confirmed — Tuesday 15:00-15:30, CSE455 staff meeting. It is on my calendar now and logged as booked. See you then.
